free_tier_limits.correction: 100 requests per day; access is limited to the regular API, species data 1-3000, hardiness maps and care guides/FAQ for species 1-3000, and plant diseases 1-100.

rate_limits.correction: Published daily quotas are 100 requests/day for Personal, 10,000/day for Premium, 100,000/day for Supreme, and custom limits for Enterprise.

description.correction: REST API providing plant species catalogs, care guides, hardiness-zone maps, and searchable plant-disease data. The documented disease endpoint is a disease list, not a disease-identification API.

notes: Perenual's official site reports the API as active and online. The directory entry misses published free-plan and paid-plan daily quotas. Its species-list example uses the legacy unversioned path; current documentation and OpenAPI materials use /api/v2/species-list. No authoritative CORS policy was located.
